dress_code.men: Darshan Dress Code: Any decent outfit; Abhishekam Dress Code: Men must remove Shirt and Vest during the Pooja.
dress_code.women: Darshan Dress Code: Any decent outfit

dos: Do take a holy bath in the Dharma Gundam or Surya Gundam before entering the queue lines.
Do maintain quiet and follow the designated line discipline during heavy rush hours.
Do deposit luggage and leather goods at the designated cloakrooms outside the complex.
Do wear a tilak or kumkum on your forehead as a mark of respect when participating in rituals.
donts: Don't wear any footwear in or around the main temple outer boundary lines.
Don't take photographs or videos inside the inner sanctum; camera equipment is strictly banned.
Don't consume non-vegetarian food, tobacco, or alcohol for at least 24 hours before your visit.
Don't carry plastics, matchboxes, or weapons inside the security check zones.
Don't approach unauthorized touts or brokers promising quick darshan or special entry slots.
Don't throw away prasadam or leaf containers anywhere outside of designated trash bins.
